title: Gift Wrap Roll

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled for the target week. The baseline median is 2.8. Recent weeks show no sustained trend or seasonal ramp; the 2026-07-13 week (3 units) is near baseline. The classical uplift model suggests no effect. Past promotions show weak, noisy lifts (median x1.15, noise-adjusted x1.0), and post-promo weeks show no lasting dip (x0.84, noise-adjusted x1.0). No driver justifies a multiplier shift. The baseline already reflects the product's high noise (95% ordinary week swing). No evidence supports a change.
